image.title: Image
image.summary: Open a flash dump and inspect it as paged hex. The opened image is used by the other calibration panels.

analyze.title: Analyze bin
analyze.summary: Work out ECU family, identity strings, catalog and definition matches, checksum status and known maps from a raw dump, with a graded confidence. Early alpha.

identify.title: Identify
identify.summary: Read the ECU identity from a dump, or type a part/software number, and match it to a bundled definition and vehicle-catalog candidates.

checksum.title: Checksum
checksum.summary: Verify the integrity fields an ECU checks before it runs an image, and recompute them after an edit.

maps.title: Maps
maps.summary: Diff two dumps to find changed regions, import XDF/A2L, and view or edit a map as a heat grid. Writes back with a full backup first.

compare.title: Compare
compare.summary: Decode every map of a definition from two images and show per map how many cells changed and by how much, in physical units.

flash.title: Flash
flash.summary: Run the safety-gated write sequence (backup to the vault, write, read-back verify) into an image file. File target only in this build: no driver choice, no voltage gate.

vault.title: Vault
vault.summary: Browse a backup folder of .bin files and their .meta sidecars with CRC-32.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.summary: List the interface drivers in this build. Use the id in the sidebar Adapter box.

project.title: Project
project.summary: Save map edits, the base image reference and its fingerprint as a small .otproj file, and reopen them later.

utils.title: Utilities
utils.summary: Offline VIN, part-number and DTC decoders, and a calculator for generic (non-OEM) seed/key transforms.

database.title: ECU database
database.summary: Searchable reference of ECUs, TCUs and AWD units: CPU, flash size, how to read them, checksum family, vehicles and bench pinouts with a confidence level.

scan.title: Auto-scan
scan.summary: Probe every module in a vehicle's module list for presence, identity and stored fault codes. Scanning is read-only; Clear all DTCs writes.

logview.title: Log viewer
logview.summary: Open a CSV datalog, plot and zoom its channels, and overlay it on a map to see which cells were used, for how long and with which values, then Open in Maps to edit that map. Units are compared, never converted.
needs: Definition + image for the map overlay

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.summary: Live gauges over OBD-II mode 01 (RPM, load, temperatures, boost, MAF, EGT, rail pressure, battery). Only values the ECU supports are shown. Record writes the polled values to a Live-log CSV for the Log viewer.

obd.title: OBD live
obd.summary: Four live readouts over generic OBD-II: RPM, coolant temperature, speed and battery voltage.

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.summary: Emissions-inspection data over generic OBD-II: check-engine lamp, readiness monitors, stored / pending / permanent codes, freeze frame, and calibration IDs with their verification numbers (CVN). One module or every OBD module.

logging.title: Live log
logging.summary: Stream ECU values from a RomRaider-style logger.xml or a pack's logger JSON (e.g. the bundled generic OBD-II mode-01 set) into a live table and save them as CSV. UDS 0x22 DIDs, OBD-II mode-01 PIDs and 0x23 memory reads are driven; identification DIDs marked as text/BCD/hex show their decoded text. Fast (0x2C) mode packs the channels into dynamically defined DIDs (one request per sample) and falls back to polling with the reason.

haldex.title: Haldex AWD
haldex.summary: OpenHaldex controller status (lock, slip) and drive mode over its UDS DIDs on 0x70F/0x779, a read-only Haldex Gen4 read (refused on real hardware until a driver opens VW TP2.0; simulated unit available), and an offline decoder for drivetrain-CAN captures with lock, clutch and temperature charts.
needs: Adapter: CAN (drivetrain CAN on PQ cars)
OpenHaldex unit, or a CAN log

ts.title: Aftermarket ECU
ts.summary: Speeduino, rusEFI and MegaSquirt through their TunerStudio INI: load and edit tunes (.msq) offline with the INI's limits, then connect over serial (or the simulated ECU), check the signature, read, plan a write, and write with a backup first, read-back verify and an optional burn. Live channel tiles.
needs: USB serial to the ECU (or sim)
Engine off, ignition on, stable supply for writes

candump.title: CAN dump
candump.summary: Capture all CAN bus traffic to a candump log, CSV or Vector ASC file with a live per-ID table. Listen-only where the adapter supports it.

coding.title: Coding
coding.summary: Read and decode a module's coding, preview a change as a dry run, and write it with a backup and read-back verify.

adaptation.title: Adaptation
adaptation.summary: Read adaptation values, run basic-settings routines and actuator tests from an adaptation definition. Tests move real parts.

service.title: Service functions
service.summary: Plan (send nothing) or run a ServiceScript procedure such as DPF regeneration, service reset, SAS calibration or EPB service mode.

autodebug.title: Auto-debug
autodebug.summary: Guided read-only self-test of the adapter and car, with prompts for actions in the car and a saveable JSON report. Alpha.

debug.title: Debug
debug.summary: Send raw UDS/OBD requests, run the offline UDS simulator and keep a session log. Alpha builds only; raw requests are sent unchecked.

guide.title: Guide
guide.summary: This offline guide: general pages and one page per panel.

about.title: About & updates
about.summary: Show the installed version and check for, download and install a signed update.
